description: A histogram or strip plot of passenger fares is heavily right-skewed. Most fares are under 100, a sparse tail runs to about 263, and a few points sit isolated near 512.
question: Most Titanic passengers paid fares well under 100, and the highest fares form a thin tail up to roughly 260. One fare sits far beyond that tail. What is the value of this extreme fare outlier?
sql: SELECT ROUND(MAX(fare), 2) AS max_fare FROM data;
title: Titanic passenger fares
